_comment: Config for scripts/audit-we-closing-dates.js. Edited by hand; not auto-generated. West End analogue of data/closing-date-audit-config.json.

urlOverrides._comment: show.id -> booking URL override, when SERP discovery (data/westend-slug-map.json) picks the wrong page or a show has no westendtheatre.com presence but a good officialUrl/other booking page exists.

openRunSkip._comment: Open-run West End long-runners (curated, not mechanically date-cut — six-the-musical-west-end-2021 opened 2019 but is unambiguously open-ended) with no announced closing horizon — the exact class of show most likely to produce a spurious anchored-date match on ordinary prose (no real 'booking until' statement exists to find). Mirrors data/closing-date-audit-config.json's openRunSkip. Remove an entry once the show announces a close — the audit will then surface a NEW_CLOSING candidate.

ambiguousAllowlist._comment: Shows where stored closingDate is human-verified correct but the booking page's window cuts off earlier. Same self-cleaning allowlist pattern as data/closing-date-audit-config.json.

jesus-christ-superstar-theatre-royal-dru.source: BRO-4808: 12-week Drury Lane season 16 Oct 2026 to Sat 9 Jan 2027 (https://www.londonboxoffice.co.uk/news/post/jesus-christ-superstar-to-extend-at-theatre-royal-drury-lane); WET page states no booking-until line.

harry-potter-and-the-cursed-child-one-pa.source: BRO-4808: booking period ends 27 June 2027 (nimaxtheatres.com, stored closingDateSource); WET page states no booking-until line.
